Description
 The Client is one of the majour insurance companies in the UK.
This role supports a high-priority risk reduction programme for the Green Flag MyCro Platform, a complex technology estate built on AWS. Platform SMEs have already designed remediation plans and started putting them into effect. The DevOps engineer we’re looking for will rebuild MyCro’s deployment pipelines on AWS native tooling and make sure logging retention and encryption policies are implemented correctly across the platform. You will join and augment an existing squad.
 Requirements
 Essential experience
Proven history of AWS development and DevOps delivery in production
Hands-on design and build of pipelines with AWS CodeBuild and CodePipeline
Configuring CloudWatch Logs retention, encryption and access at scale
Infrastructure as code on AWS
 Technologies and tools
CI/CD: AWS CodePipeline, CodeBuild, CodeDeploy, CodeArtifact (as applicable)
Logging and monitoring: Amazon CloudWatch Logs, CloudWatch metrics and alarms, log subscription filters
Security: AWS KMS, IAM, AWS Config rules for compliance checks
Infrastructure as code: AWS CloudFormation and/or AWS CDK, or Terraform
Workloads: AWS Lambda, Amazon ECS
Scripting: Python, Bash, buildspec YAML
 Nice to have
Pipeline security practices (supply-chain controls, secrets handling, signed artefacts)
Migrating live services between CI/CD systems
AWS certification (e.g. DevOps Engineer – Professional)
 Job responsibilities
Re-implement the platform’s deployment pipelines using AWS CodePipeline, CodeBuild and related services, following the agreed remediation plan
Build security and confidence into delivery: least-privilege pipeline roles, approval gates, artefact integrity, automated testing and safe rollback
Migrate services from existing pipelines to the new ones with no disruption to releases
Audit CloudWatch log groups and apply the correct retention periods across the estate
Enforce encryption of logs at rest using AWS KMS, including key policies and rotation
Improve logging hygiene: consistent structure, removal of sensitive data from logs, and removal of noisy or orphaned log groups
Codify all changes as infrastructure as code so policies cannot drift
Document pipelines and logging standards and hand them over to the squad
